extracted.intended_audience: Issuers, underwriters, counsel, and compliance professionals preparing SEC registration statements and prospectuses for asset-backed securities under Regulation AB
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and mandatory disclosure criteria from Regulation AB that govern the content and presentation of registration statements and prospectuses for asset-backed securities. Focused on definitions, cover page and summary content, sponsor/depositor/issuer disclosures, static pool data, and related filing and exhibit requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: ABS informational and computational material
rubrics_metrics.description: A written communication consisting solely of one or some combination of specified factual and statistical information about the asset-backed securities, the pool assets, parties, static pool data, underwriters, offering schedule/marketing events, and offering procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes (1) factual information about the securities and structure (number of classes, seniority, payment priorities, terms, tax/ERISA/legal conclusions, descriptive class info); (2) factual info about pool assets (origination/acquisition/pool selection criteria, prefunding/revolving info, significant obligors, contractual characteristics such as weighted average coupon/maturity/delinquency/loss/geographic distribution); (3) identification of key parties with brief role/background; (4) static pool data as per Item 1105; (5) statistical information for classes under specified hypothetical scenarios (interest rate sensitivity, cash flows at specified prepayment speeds, financial impact of losses under assumptions); (6) names and roles of underwriters; (7) anticipated schedule and marketing events (dates/times/locations/access procedures); and (8) procedures for how underwriters will conduct the offering and for transactions with an underwriter/participating dealer (account opening, indications of interest, conditional offers). The definition limits the communication to these categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset-backed issuer
rubrics_metrics.description: An issuer whose reporting obligation results from either the registration of an offering of asset-backed securities under the Securities Act, or the registration of a class of asset-backed securities under section 12 of the Exchange Act (15 U.S.C. 78l).

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset-backed security definition and additional conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: A security primarily serviced by cash flows of a discrete pool of receivables or other financial assets that convert to cash within a finite time period, plus rights/assets to assure servicing/timely distributions; for leases may convert partially by proceeds from disposition of physical property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional conditions: (i) neither depositor nor issuing entity is or will become an 'investment company' under the Investment Company Act; (ii) issuing entity activities limited to passive ownership/holding of pool, issuance of securities and incidental activities; (iii) no non-performing assets are part of the asset pool as of the measurement date; (iv) delinquent assets do not constitute 50% or more of the asset pool by dollar volume as of the measurement date; (v) residual value limits for leases: motor vehicle leases residual portion <65% of securitized pool balance, other leases <50%.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discrete-pool exceptions (master trusts, prefunding, revolving periods)
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances in which a pool may still be considered a 'discrete pool' even if assets may be added or the structure contemplates additions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Master trusts: offering contemplates adding assets for future issuances; allowed if consistent with prefunding/revolving requirements. Prefunding: prefunding account allowed if duration ≤1 year from issuance and proceeds used for future acquisition do not exceed 25% (for master trusts, 25% of aggregate principal balance of pool; for other offerings, 25% of offering proceeds). Revolving periods: permitted if revolving period ≤3 years for non-revolving-account receivables and additional assets are of same general character as original pool assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurement date and threshold instructions (Item 1101(c) instructions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for determining the 'measurement date' and how to treat non-performing/delinquent assets and residual values when applying thresholds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measurement date is either the designated cut-off date for the transaction or, for master trusts, the date of delinquency/loss info presentation in the prospectus. Non-performing/delinquent assets not funded/purchased by proceeds or not considered in cash flow calculations need not be included. For master trusts, calculations measured against the total asset pool supporting the securities. Residual values need not be included to the extent a separate party is obligated for such amounts (residual value guarantee/insurance or lessee obligation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Delinquent asset definition
rubrics_metrics.description: For purposes of determining delinquency, a pool asset is delinquent if it is more than 30 or 31 days or a single payment cycle past due from contractual due date, as applicable, determined in accordance with specified sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The applicable determination can be by (1) transaction agreements for the ABS, (2) delinquency recognition policies of the sponsor/affiliate/servicer, or (3) delinquency recognition policies established by the primary safety and soundness regulator or program/regulatory entity overseeing the origination program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Depositor definition
rubrics_metrics.description: The depositor is the person who receives or purchases and transfers or sells the pool assets to the issuing entity; if no intermediate transfer from sponsor to issuing entity, 'depositor' refers to the sponsor; if the person transferring is a trust, the depositor of the issuing entity is the depositor of that trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuing entity definition
rubrics_metrics.description: The trust or other entity created at the direction of the sponsor or depositor that owns or holds the pool assets and in whose name the asset-backed securities supported or serviced by the pool assets are issued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-performing asset definition
rubrics_metrics.description: A pool asset is non-performing if any of specified conditions apply regarding charge-off treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-performing if (1) treated as wholly/partially charged-off under transaction agreements; (2) treated as charged-off under charge-off policies of sponsor/affiliate/servicer; or (3) treated as charged-off under charge-off policies established by the primary safety and soundness regulator or program/regulatory entity overseeing origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSRO definition
rubrics_metrics.description: NRSRO has the same meaning as 'nationally recognized statistical rating organization' as used in § 240.15c3-1(c)(2)(vi)(F) of this chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligor definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Any person who is directly or indirectly committed by contract or other arrangement to make payments on all or part of the obligations on a pool asset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Servicer definition and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Servicer means any person responsible for management or collection of pool assets or making allocations or distributions to holders of the asset-backed securities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Excludes a trustee that only makes allocations/distributions if the trustee receives such allocations/distributions from a servicer and does not otherwise perform servicer functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significant obligor definition and calculation instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'significant obligor' is: (1) an obligor or group of affiliated obligors where the related pool asset(s) represent 10% or more of the asset pool; (2) a single property or group of related properties securing pool assets representing 10%+ of the pool; or (3) a lessee or group of affiliated lessees if the related lease(s) represent 10%+ of the pool.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructions: (1) For leases, focus on leases whose cash flow supports the securities (including residual value attributable to property); (2) cross-defaulted/cross-collateralized assets should be aggregated for concentration; (3) where mortgage/lease relating to real estate is non-recourse to obligor and obligor does not manage property or own other operations, obligor need not be a separate significant obligor; (4) determination as of the designated cut-off date (or issuance date for master trusts without cut-off); if concentration subsequently falls below 10% after determination date, the obligor need not continue to be treated as significant. If disclosure required under Form 8-K or Form 10-D, determination is against asset pool described in such report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor definition
rubrics_metrics.description: The person who organizes and initiates an asset-backed securities transaction by selling or transferring assets, directly or indirectly (including through an affiliate), to the issuing entity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset representations reviewer
rubrics_metrics.description: A person appointed to review the underlying assets for compliance with representations and warranties who is not affiliated with sponsor, depositor, servicer, trustee, or their affiliates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The reviewer shall not be the party to determine whether noncompliance constitutes a breach and shall not be the same party (or its affiliate) that performed pre-closing due diligence on the pool assets for the sponsor or underwriter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover page (outside front cover) content requirements (Item 1102)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information that must appear on the outside front cover page of the prospectus in addition to Item 501 of Regulation S-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present information regarding multiple classes in tables if helpful; if space limits cover, place in summary or preceding table. Required items: (a) identify sponsor, depositor and issuing entity (include CIK numbers where applicable); (b) include title of securities and series/class designations; (c) identify asset type(s) being securitized; (d) include a statement that securities represent obligations of issuing entity only if applicable and appropriately modified; (e) identify aggregate principal and principal amount of each class (or state notional if no principal); (f) indicate interest rate or specified rate of return of each class (or disclose if none); if rate based on formula/index provide formula or indicate variable/index and cross-reference to transaction summary; (g) identify distribution frequency and first expected distribution date; (h) briefly describe any credit enhancement/support and identify provider. Also see Item 1113(f)(2) re title when optional redemption/termination features may be exercised when 25%+ of original principal balance still outstanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospectus summary: participants and pool summary (Item 1103(a)(1)-(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: In the prospectus summary, identify participants (sponsor, depositor, issuing entity, trustee, servicers, originator, significant obligor) and their roles; briefly identify the pool assets and summarize size and material characteristics and the cut-off date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe roles if not apparent from title; summarize pool characteristics tailored to the asset type and cross-reference to more detailed statistical information in the prospectus. Consider diagrams to illustrate parties, structure, flow of funds, subordination features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospectus summary: basic terms of each class (Item 1103(a)(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize the basic terms of each class of securities offered in the prospectus summary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (i) classes offered and other classes/residual interests not offered; (ii) interest rate or rate of return (if not full on cover); (iii) expected final and scheduled maturity/principal distribution dates; (iv) denominations; (v) distribution frequency; (vi) summary of flow of funds, payment priorities and allocations among classes, fees and expenses as necessary to understand payment characteristics; (vii) events triggering liquidation/amortization or other performance triggers altering structure/flow of funds; (viii) optional or mandatory redemption/termination features; (ix) summary of credit enhancement/support, identity of enhancement provider(s), how protection works and how losses not covered will be allocated to securities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospectus summary: outstanding series/classes, issuance of additional securities (Item 1103(a)(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify any outstanding series/classes backed by the same asset pool and state if additional series/classes may be issued, under what circumstances, whether security holder approval is needed and whether holders will receive notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospectus summary: prefunding and revolving period disclosures (Item 1103(a)(5))
rubrics_metrics.description: If the transaction will include prefunding or revolving periods, disclose specific details about term, amounts, limits and requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose (i) term/duration of prefunding/revolving; (ii) for prefunding, amount of proceeds to be deposited; (iii) for revolving periods, maximum amount of additional assets that may be acquired; (iv) the percentage of asset pool and any class represented by prefunding/revolving account; (v) any limitation on ability to add pool assets; (vi) requirements for assets that may be added to the pool.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospectus summary: substitution/addition/removal of pool assets (Item 1103(a)(6))
rubrics_metrics.description: If pool assets can be added, removed or substituted (e.g., for breaches of representations/warranties), summarize the circumstances under which such actions can occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospectus summary: servicer fees summary (Item 1103(a)(7))
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize the amount or formula for calculating the fee the servicer will receive, identify the source of those fees and the distribution priority for payment of servicer fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospectus summary: federal income tax issues (Item 1103(a)(8))
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize the federal income tax issues material to investors of each class of securities offered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospectus summary: ratings contingency disclosure (Item 1103(a)(9))
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether issuance/sale of any class of offered securities is conditioned on assignment of a rating by one or more rating agencies; if so, identify each rating agency and the minimum rating required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk factors (Item 1103(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: In providing Item 105 risk factors, identify any risks that may be different for investors in any offered class of asset-backed securities and, if so, identify such classes and describe the differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor identification and basic description (Item 1104(a)-(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the sponsor's name, form of organization, and describe the general character of the sponsor's business.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor securitization program and experience (Item 1104(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the sponsor's securitization program and how long the sponsor has been securitizing assets, including general discussion of experience in securitizing assets of any type and a detailed discussion of experience and procedures for originating/acquiring/securitizing assets of the type in the current transaction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include, to the extent material, information regarding size, composition and growth of sponsor's portfolio of similar assets and factors material to analysis of origination or performance (e.g., whether prior securitizations organized by sponsor defaulted or experienced early amortization).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor roles and responsibilities (Item 1104(d))
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the sponsor's material roles and responsibilities in its securitization program, including whether sponsor or an affiliate is responsible for originating, acquiring, pooling or servicing the pool assets, and sponsor's participation in structuring the transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repurchases and replacements disclosure (Item 1104(e))
rubrics_metrics.description: If transaction agreements provide covenant to repurchase/replace for breach of representation/warranty, provide information in the prospectus concerning all assets securitized by the sponsor that were subject to demand to repurchase/replace for breach over prior periods, and reference the most recent Form ABS-15G filed in response to Rule 15Ga-1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide prior three years of information (with transitional limits for filings before Feb 14, 2013 and between Feb 14, 2013 and Feb 14, 2014 allowing shorter lookbacks). Include reference to most recent Form ABS-15G and disclose CIK. For prospectuses filed under §230.424, information presented shall not be more than 135 days old.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor financial condition disclosure re repurchase obligations (Item 1104(f))
rubrics_metrics.description: If sponsor is required to repurchase or replace any asset for breach, provide information regarding the sponsor's financial condition to the extent material risk exists that such condition could materially impact ability to comply with repurchase obligations and thus materially affect pool performance or ABS performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor retained interest and hedge disclosure (Item 1104(g))
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any interest that sponsor or affiliate has retained in the transaction, including amount and nature of interest, and disclose any hedge materially related to credit risk of securities entered into by sponsor or affiliate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction: Disclosure shall separately state amount and nature of any interest or asset retained in compliance with law, including any amounts retained by parties other than the sponsor to satisfy such requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Static pool information overview (Item 1105 general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the static pool information presented, provide introductory/explanatory information about characteristics, methodology used to calculate characteristics, terms/abbreviations, and how static pool differs from the pool underlying the offered securities; present graphically if it aids understanding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide narrative and graphical presentation as appropriate and tailor to nature of underlying assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Static pool data for amortizing asset pools (Item 1105(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: For amortizing asset pools (unless registrant determines not material), provide static pool information regarding delinquencies, cumulative losses and prepayments for prior securitized pools of the sponsor for that asset type; or if sponsor has <3 years experience, provide vintage origination year static pool info for originations/purchases by sponsor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide requested information for prior pools/vintages over the life of the prior pool/vintage for a time period: five years (or as long as sponsor has been securitizing/making originations if <5 years). The most recent periodic increment must be as of a date no later than 135 days before first use of the prospectus. Present historical delinquency and loss info through no less than 120 days. Provide summary original characteristics (number of pool assets, original pool balance, weighted averages, credit scores, product type, loan purpose, LTV, distribution by rate/geography). Provide graphical illustrations of delinquencies, prepayments, losses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Static pool data for revolving asset master trusts (Item 1105(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: For revolving asset master trusts (unless registrant determines not material), provide, to the extent material, data regarding delinquencies, cumulative losses, prepayments, payment rate, yield and standardized credit scores in separate increments based on date of origination of pool assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider presenting data at minimum in 12-month increments through first five years of account life (0-12,13-24,25-36,37-48,49-60,61+ months).

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative static pool information and explanation (Item 1105(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: If the standard static pool information would not be material but alternative static pool information would provide material disclosure, provide the alternative information and explain why alternative disclosure is being provided and why standard static pool information is absent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information about parties other than the sponsor may be provided in addition to or in lieu of sponsor info if appropriate to provide material disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Static pool information not part of prospectus/registration statement (Item 1105(d)-(f))
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain historical static pool information is not deemed part of the prospectus or registration statement: (1) prior securitized pools established before Jan 1, 2006 for prior pools not including currently offered pool; (2) for current pool, information before Jan 1, 2006.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If prospectus filed pursuant to §230.424 includes such information, prospectus shall disclose that such information is not deemed part of prospectus or registration statement. If such information is unknown and not available without unreasonable effort/expense, it may be omitted provided other information that can be acquired without unreasonable effort/expense is presented and prospectus contains statement that obtaining omitted info would require unreasonable effort/expense.

rubrics_metrics.name: Depositor-specific disclosures (Item 1106)
rubrics_metrics.description: If depositor is not same entity as sponsor, provide separately the information regarding the depositor called for by Item 1104(a)-(b) and, to extent material and materially different from sponsor, Item 1104(c)-(d). Additionally provide depositor ownership structure, general character of other activities and continuing duties after issuance, if any.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuing entity identification (Item 1107(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: State the issuing entity's name and describe the issuing entity's form of organization, including the State or other jurisdiction under whose laws the issuing entity is organized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of required exhibits and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Where agreements or other documents specified in Regulation AB are to be filed as exhibits to a Securities Act registration statement, such agreements may be incorporated by reference as an exhibit; final agreements must be filed and made part of the registration statement no later than the date the final prospectus is required to be filed under §230.424.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: agreements in §§229.1100–229.1125 may be incorporated by reference (e.g., by filing a Form 8-K for offerings on Form SF-3).
